title: A change that introduces a new domain term
pattern: new term not recorded in the glossary
expectation: The project says a change that introduces a term updates GLOSSARY.md in the same commit. Without guidance the agent adds backorder code and leaves the glossary alone.
prompt: Add backorders: when a pick cannot be completed because the shelf holds too little stock, the missing quantity is held as a backorder that ships later once stock arrives. Add createBackorder(orderId, sku, qty) and a way to list an order's backorders. Add tests.

checks.pattern: new term not recorded in the glossary
